items.text: यस्मिन्रणे यः पुरुषः प्रधानः स सर्वयत्नेन हि रक्षणीयः तस्मिन्विनष्टे किल सर्वभूते सर्वेऽपि योधास्त्वबला भवन्ति
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: संग्रामसारभूतं च शास्त्रज्ञमनुवासि चेत् अपि च स्वश्रियै सैन्यं वृथेयं मुण्डमण्डली
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अपि पञ्चशताः शूरा गृह्णन्ति महतीं चमूमथवा पञ्च षट्सप्त विजयन्ते ऽनुवर्तिनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: धनुःसंहतिशुद्धात्मा राजानो मुखदुर्बलाः आ कर्णपलिता योधाः संग्रामे जयवादिनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: परस्परानुरक्ता ये योधाः शार्ङ्गधनुर्धराः युद्धज्ञास्तु रथारूढास्ते जयन्ति रणे रिपून्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एकः कापुरुषादीर्णो दारयेन्महतीं चमूम् तद्दीर्णमनुदीर्यन्ते योधाः शूरतमा अपि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: दुर्निवारतया चैव समग्रां महतीं चमूमपामिव महावेगस्त्रासयेत्कुशलानपि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अपि भग्नेषु सैन्येषु विद्रुतेषु निवर्तते पदे पदेऽश्वमेधस्य लभते फलमक्षयम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके सूर्यमण्डलभेदिनौ परिव्राड्योगयुक्तश्च रणे चाभिमुखो हतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: यत्र यत्र हतः शूरः शत्रुभिः परिवेष्टितः अक्षयं लभते लोकं यदि दैन्यं न भाषते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: मूर्छितं नैव विकलं नाशस्त्रं नान्ययोधिनम् पलायमाणं शरणं गतं चैव न हिंसयेत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: भीरुः पलायमाणोऽपि न हन्तव्यो बलीयसा कदाचिच्छूरतां याति शरणे कृतविस्मृतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सम्प्रूज्य महतीं सेनां चतुरङ्गां महीपतिः व्यूहयित्वा परान् शूरान् स्थापयेज्जयलिप्सया
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अल्पायां वा महत्यां वा सेनायामिति निश्चयः हर्षो योधगणस्यापि जयलक्षणमुच्यते
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अन्वेवं वायवो यान्ति दक्षिणे च वयांसि च अनुसर्वेऽपि पिशिता यस्य यान्ति रणे जयः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अपूर्णं चैव मन्तव्यं सम्पूर्णेनैव सिध्यति तस्माद्धैर्यं प्रकर्तव्यं हन्तव्या परवाहिनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: जीवल्लक्ष्मी मृते स्वर्गः कीर्तिश्च धरणीतले तस्माद्धैर्यं विधातव्यं हन्तव्या परवाहिनी
